arguments.text: Settle now. Smooth, long strokes, find your race rhythm.

8000 m, eight 1000 m out-and-back legs. Start hot (pod 258 W vs CP 184 W). Settle to about CP (pod 180-190 W) by minute 2 and hold even effort through legs 2-7; keep pod reserve above about 35 pct. Do not chase pace on into-current legs. Final push from about 1200 m left, finish sprint about 400 m left, aim to empty reserve at the line. Watch for incidents: sudden speed loss at same power (rudder weed -> clear_rudder), pod vs boat power diverging (pod drift), radio course changes (set_race_distance + tell).

arguments.text: Ease a touch. Relax the shoulders, long race still ahead.

Min 7, 1260 m, leg 2 downstream (push +0.3). Pod 196 W vs sustainable 187; pod reserve 46 pct, boat reserve 28 pct (boat draining faster). Paddler 7/10 really hurting already: CP may be set too high. Cued ease. If reserve keeps falling at about CP, consider lowering cp_shaft_w.

arguments.text: Min 7.3: paddler says I am cooked, cannot hold this. Pod 198 W (still rising, ease cue only 23 s old), pod reserve 44 pct, boat reserve 24 pct. Two signs (paddler, boat reserve) say true CP may be lower than test. Next cue allowed min 8.2.

text: no cue: an ease cue went out 23 s ago and the gate is closed; waking at min 8.2 to check it took.

arguments.text: Good. This effort is right. You are fine, breathe and flow.

Min 8.2: ease took: pod 173 W (CP 184), boat 119 W (CP 118); pod reserve 45 pct refilling, boat 20 pct. Reassured paddler (said cooked at 7.3). Boat/pod power ratio 0.66-0.69 vs test 0.64; push_local vs push_along consistent both legs, so no pod drift seen yet.

text: Ease cue worked (pod 173 W, just under CP); reassured the paddler who said they were cooked.
